notes:
No pre-existing cached text or terminal miss. Both DOI landing pages verified supplied titles but did not provide full text. Unpaywall and OpenAlex reported no open-access full-text location; Europe PMC returned bibliographic records without an open-access full text. Publisher access returned 403; no challenge retries. Replication institutional repository contained metadata only, and IslandScholar returned a challenge. Search did not yield an accessible primary full paper; abstracts and publisher section previews were not accepted as full-paper acquisition. No statistics or narrative verdict extracted from previews. An excluded-domain result was unexpectedly surfaced by the initial general paper search; it was not opened or used. No repository search performed.
Source follow-up: Primary page 447 rendered and statistics verified. The overall DEX effect is extracted as a candidate; target_match remains null because the neutral locator does not distinguish it from light-phase F(1,28) = 5.963, P = 0.021 or dark-phase F(1,28) = 3.462, P = 0.073. Author replication verdict specifically references light-phase finding; no phase-specific p merged into overall test.
Source follow-up: Figure 3 caption gives n12–20 per group; exact analytic total for initial block not explicitly printed. Description/locator also cover final block F(2,86)=7.157, P=.001; selected first stated prenatal exposure main effect, with ambiguity retained. Rendered primary target page inspected; test numerals verified.
